answer: A sequential-work gate resists Sybils: before an agent can transact, it must finish a chain of small, time-ordered puzzles that cannot be parallelized, like walking a single path over a knoll rather than cloning the walker. Each step depends on the previous one, so ten fake identities take ten times the wall-clock time, not ten times the hardware. Add a saffron-priced entry fee, refundable after honest work, and a juniper registry of completed chains peers can audit. The attacker pays real time plus locked funds; honest agents pay once and keep standing.
